title: Wyoming governor decries ‘aggressive’ behavior of federal election monitors
description: The Justice Department sent observers during the state’s primary election this month. A local official said the activities exceeded their authority.

title: Judge rejects Trump’s latest bid to challenge hush money conviction
description: The court rejected Trump’s third attempt to move the case to federal court, where the president believes he would benefit from broader protection from prosecution.

title: Trump announces creation of U.S. Space Academy
description: The school will serve the Space Force, the sixth and newest branch of the military President Donald Trump created during his first term, as well as NASA and the growing civilian spaceflight industry.

title: Rep. Crockett says she’ll be campaigning ‘downballot’ instead of with Talarico
description: The congresswoman, who lost the primary Senate race to state Rep. James Talarico, did not mention him by name.

title: Trump suggests cattle ranchers could bypass USDA-inspected meat plants
description: A deregulation plan for meat-packing goes from Glenn Beck’s mouth to Trump’s social media.

title: Trees are coming down by the dozen as Trump’s D.C. golf makeover nears
description: The president’s promised overhaul of the East Potomac course has not officially begun, but tree removal has already been taking place for weeks.

title: White South Africans could get $4,500 in aid if they come to U.S. as refugees
description: The assistance, which helps pay for basic needs such as housing and food, would nearly double under a new policy.

title: Trump promised a short Iran war. Six months later, he has few good options.
description: The Iran war has become a major feature of Trump’s second term, hurting his standing with voters at home and eroding the U.S. position in the Middle East.

title: Measles’ role in child’s death ignites fight between RFK Jr. and Pennsylvania governor
description: A county coroner said that the pathologist who examined a newborn who tested positive for measles did not believe the virus played a role in the baby’s death.

title: Trump signs order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America
description: President Trump has signed an executive order to rename Lake Ontario as "Lake America."

title: The Social Security trust fund is running out, and yet it's not a top campaign issue
description: Limited public discussion of the trust fund's shortfall has experts worried that most Americans don't fully understand the problems Social Security faces — let alone be able to weigh in on solutions.

title: How Democrats in Congress are preparing for Trump midterm election interference
description: As Election Day draws nearer, Democrats are preparing for a range of scenarios, intent on avoiding what they see as the failure of imagination that kept lawmakers from anticipating the Jan. 6 attack.

title: Trump administration proposal would allow federal grants to be terminated on a whim
description: New Trump-led proposals to change how federal grants are decided could spell trouble for blue cities and states, The Indicator reports.

title: Norway's King Harald V dies at 89 and his son becomes King Haakon VIII
description: King Harald V of Norway, who went into exile in the United States as a child during the Nazi occupation of his homeland and refused a string of European noblewomen to marry his school sweetheart, died Friday.

title: Judge issues new block on Trump’s sweeping restrictions on mail-in voting
description: The legal fight over the controversial measure is expected to continue.

title: What a fake poll reveals about worries around prediction markets and the midterms
description: While a stunt involving fake polls may not have been an effort to rig prediction markets, concerns are growing ahead of the midterms about other attempts to influence the betting sites.

title: Trump signs order renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America, escalating Canada feud
description: President Donald Trump said he's making the change because “Canada has been ripping us off for a long time on trade, very sadly.”

title: Rep. Chuck Edwards argues ‘affectionate friendship’ is not grounds for censure
description: In a 22-page letter, the North Carolina Republican sought to rebut an ethics report that concluded he engaged in “persistent unprofessional and inappropriate conduct.”

title: Lake America merch is already available, if you have a sense of humor
description: A new site offers “officially unofficial” items “for a place that may or may not exist.”

title: Susan Collins agrees to four debates ahead of Senate election in Maine
description: Sen. Susan Collins (R-Maine) has accepted invitations to four debates ahead of November’s election in a state that has become crucial to each party’s potential path to power in the Senate.

title: Secret Service spokesman is put on leave amid investigation
description: The agency said two other non-law enforcement employees were also suspended in an unspecified misconduct investigation.

title: The political battle over grocery prices is here
description: President Donald Trump is trying to lower beef prices ahead of the midterms.

title: Karoline Leavitt says she’ll miss the press on her last day at White House
description: A replacement press secretary may not be named for a while, advisers suggest.

title: Political bickering follows two deaths related to measles in Pennsylvania
description: This week, Pennsylvania officials reported two measles-related deaths. Those deaths have now become wrapped up in politics. The country is in the midst of a record-setting number of measles cases.

title: Pirro’s special grand jury probing D.C. schools, city oversight of youth
description: The unusual investigation appears to have a broad scope. Prosecutors have contacted D.C. Public Schools personnel to question them about truancy and graduation rates.

title: New coalition fights Trump’s efforts to weaken protections for historic sites
description: A coalition of preservation groups says the regulatory, legislative and executive efforts pose the greatest threat in 60 years to a law requiring federal agencies to avoid harm to historic sites.

title: We know you care about the environment because you’re sweating
description: A novel study compared the issues survey respondents said were important to their physiological reactions in a lab.

title: Trump directs federal government to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America
description: President Trump signed an executive order on Thursday directing the federal government to rename Lake Ontario amid an escalating trade dispute with Canada .

title: World’s nuclear watchdog endorses Trump’s push for Kim Jong Un meeting
description: In an interview with The Washington Post, Rafael Mariano Grossi, one of the world’s most respected arms control experts, backed the case for dialogue.

title: A former Mike Collins staffer posted KKK and Nazi images. Some Republicans see a pattern.
description: Rep. Mike Collins (R-Georgia) is challenging Sen. Jon Ossoff (D). The former Collins staffer posted a swastika and shared an image of himself in what appear to be KKK robes.

title: El-Sayed’s ties to firebrand influencer threaten Democrats’ path to control Senate
description: Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed (D) has close political ties to political commentator Hasan Piker, who has been accused of antisemitism. Piker says his comments against Israel have been misunderstood.

title: The 2026 midterms are exposing Democrats’ dilemma over race, power, and the House
description: In their bid to counter GOP redistricting, Democrats debate breaking up Black-held districts.

title: Trump keeps boosting data centers, even as other Republicans grow critical
description: The president is defending the data center boom as GOP officials across the country turn against projects that have angered voters.

title: Trump under pressure at home and abroad as midterms approach
description: President Trump is under pressure internationally and domestically as the year's primary elections near an end.

title: A look at Trump's inner circle and the increased resistance from some of his allies
description: NPR's A Martínez asks Chris Whipple, the Vanity Fair writer who spent time inside the Trump administration, why the president is experiencing increasing resistance to his plans.

title: Fired FEMA crew leader defends skipping homes with Trump campaign signs
description: Marni Washington said she was following protocol to keep field workers safe in a politicized environment following 2024’s Hurricane Milton.

title: Judge lifts block on Trump changes to mail voting, though legal fights continue
description: The president’s executive order is now in effect for the midterm elections, but the ruling leaves the door open to renewed challenges from rights groups.

title: Alaska’s weird (and important) Senate race
description: There will be two Dan Sullivans on the ballot, which greatly benefits Democrats.

title: Trump visa restrictions will worsen strains on the economy, experts say
description: Several Trump administration moves to restrict legal immigration, including a pause in visa appointments and the cancellation of tourism and business visas, will harm the economy and workforce, experts say.
